name: api.create

params.name: name
params.description: Optional nice name for the created layer.

description: Creates a new layer or node of the specified type in the active composition. Note: new layers inherit the current selection as parent unless api.select([]) is called first.

name: api.primitive

params.name: name
params.description: Display name for the created basicShape layer.

description: Creates a parametric basicShape layer pre-configured with the specified primitive generator.

name: api.createEditable

params.name: name
params.description: Display name for the editableShape layer.

description: Creates an editable bezier vector layer from a cavalry.Path instance.
example: const p = new cavalry.Path(); p.moveTo(0, 0); p.lineTo(100, 0); const id = api.createEditable(p, 'Line');

name: api.get
description: Reads the evaluated value of an attribute on a layer at the current playhead frame.

name: api.set
signature: api.set(layerId: string, attributes: Record<string, unknown>): void

params.name: attributes
params.description: Attribute map. Compound/color attributes must be sent in separate api.set calls.

description: Sets one or more static attribute values on a layer. Split compound attributes (position, scale, generator.dimensions, material.materialColor) into individual api.set calls.

name: api.setGenerator
signature: api.setGenerator(layerId: string, attrPath: string, generatorType: string): void
description: Switches the active generator type on a layer attribute such as a duplicator's distribution.

name: api.connect
signature: api.connect(srcLayerId: string, srcAttr: string, dstLayerId: string, dstAttr: string, force?: boolean): void

params.name: force
params.description: Optional flag to overwrite an existing single connection.

description: Wires an output attribute of one node to an input attribute of another node.

name: api.keyframe
signature: api.keyframe(layerId: string, frame: number, attributes: Record<string, unknown>): void

params.name: attributes
params.description: Single-attribute or scalar dictionary to keyframe at frame.

description: Creates or updates a keyframe at the specified frame.

name: api.magicEasing
signature: api.magicEasing(layerId: string, attrPath: string, frame: number, easingName: string, expression?: string): void

params.name: expression
params.description: Optional curve expression, only valid when easingName is 'Custom' or 'None'.

description: Assigns a Cavalry Magic Easing preset to the outgoing segment of a keyframe.

name: api.modifyKeyframe
signature: api.modifyKeyframe(layerId: string, spec: Record<string, { frame: number; newFrame?: number; newValue?: unknown; type?: number }>): void

params.name: spec
params.description: Map of attrPath to modification descriptor { frame, newFrame?, newValue?, type? }.

description: Retimes or updates an existing keyframe's value or interpolation mode in place without disturbing neighbour tangents.

name: api.modifyKeyframeTangent
signature: api.modifyKeyframeTangent(layerId: string, spec: Record<string, { frame: number; inHandle: boolean; outHandle: boolean; angle?: number; weight?: number; angleLocked?: boolean; weightLocked?: boolean }>): void

params.name: spec
params.description: Map of attrPath to tangent handle descriptor.

description: Adjusts explicit cubic Bézier tangent angle and weight handles on an existing keyframe.
example: api.modifyKeyframeTangent(id, { 'position.y': { frame: 0, inHandle: false, outHandle: true, angle: 0, weight: 8 } });

name: api.getBoundingBox
signature: api.getBoundingBox(layerId: string, worldSpace?: boolean): { x: number; y: number; width: number; height: number; centre: { x: number; y: number } }

params.name: worldSpace
params.description: True for composition world-space AABB, false for local layer bounds.

returns: { x: number, y: number, width: number, height: number, centre: { x: number, y: number } }
description: Measures the axis-aligned bounding box of a layer at the current playhead frame. Essential for centering textShape layers and auto-sizing pill backgrounds.

name: api.getNiceName
description: Returns the user-visible display name of a layer. Always use api.getNiceName instead of the non-existent api.getName.

name: api.getName
description: DEPRECATED / NON-EXISTENT TRAP: api.getName does not exist in Cavalry 2.7+/2.8+. Use api.getNiceName(layerId) instead.

name: api.addDynamic
signature: api.addDynamic(layerId: string, attrType: string, attrName: string): string

params.name: layerId
params.description: Host layer ID (such as a master Controller Null).

params.name: attrName
params.description: Name of the custom dynamic attribute.

description: Adds a custom user-facing dynamic slider, colour swatch, or toggle to a control null layer (Controllerizer pattern).

name: api.parent
description: Parents childLayerId under parentLayerId in the scene hierarchy.

name: api.renderPNGFrame
description: Synchronously renders the active composition at the current playhead frame to a PNG file on disk.

name: api.startUndoGroup

params.name: label
params.description: Name shown in Cavalry's Edit > Undo menu.

description: Opens an atomic Undo transaction. Always pair with api.endUndoGroup() inside a try/finally block.
example: api.startUndoGroup('Build Rig'); try { /* ops */ } finally { api.endUndoGroup(); }

name: cavalry.Path
description: Constructs and manipulates 2D vector bezier paths with moveTo(x,y), lineTo(x,y), curveTo(cp1x,cp1y,cp2x,cp2y,x,y), quadTo(cpx,cpy,x,y), closePath(), and contours().
example: const p = new cavalry.Path(); p.moveTo(-50, 0); p.lineTo(50, 0); p.closePath();

name: ctx.index
description: Zero-based index of the current clone/point/sub-mesh being evaluated inside a JavaScript Modifier, Deformer, or Duplicator context.
